name: Sample Ichor
summary: In Silverpine Forest, Sample Ichor carries traces of necromancy and warlock sorcery. Apothecary Renferrel refined it from the fluid that sustains the Rot Hide gnolls.

sections.title: Unraveling the Rot Hides
sections.body: Apothecary Renferrel sent Sample Ichor to the Undercity for closer study. He recovered samples from the Rot Hide gnolls and their lingering remnants, then reduced the foul liquid to its base components. His analysis showed that the ichor was made through necromantic rites woven with warlock magic. Since its craft reaches beyond simple alchemy, Renferrel sent the sample to Bethor Iceshard for divination.

faq.answer: Sample Ichor is a refined extract Apothecary Renferrel prepared from the bodily fluids of the Rot Hide gnolls. He separated it into its base components to learn how magic was used to create the walking dead beasts.

faq.q: Who needs to see this sample?
aliases: who do i bring the ichor to
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard needs to examine the sample. He is an undead mage stationed in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, where his skill in divination and magical traditions can reveal traces ordinary alchemy cannot discern.

faq.q: What kind of magic is inside the ichor?
aliases: what magic is in the ichor
faq.answer: The ichor contains warlock and necromantic magic bound into the fluid. Bethor Iceshard notes that the vial is laced with powerful, ancient enchantments, requiring deeper divination to uncover fully.

faq.q: Why didn't the apothecaries finish analyzing it themselves?
aliases: why not renounce rot hide ichor
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society excels in alchemy, toxins, and bodily blights, while complex arcane weaves call for a dedicated sorcerer. Bethor Iceshard can identify magical schools and unravel esoteric spells beyond an apothecary's usual tools.

angles.text: As a warlock, you may recognize the warlock arts Apothecary Renferrel detected interwoven with necromancy in the ichor, hinting that fel practices helped bind these undead beasts.
As a mage, you know the value of classical arcane analysis against dark sorcery. Bethor Iceshard uses specialized divination spells to read the residue in the sample.
